collection_mode: Frozen public-source CSV exports and official company disclosures; normalization is reproducible offline. Online downloads can have access limits or revised history.

sources.adjustment: Provider historical basis; an earlier archive alignment applied factor 0.8875 to OHLC, not volume. This is not an unadjusted historical-vintage archive.

sources.unit: USD per troy ounce; multiply aligned gold and FX to obtain VND per troy ounce

sources.provider: Investing.com economic calendar, source General Statistics Office of Vietnam

sources.availability_rule: year-end plus 180 calendar days; assumed rather than an observed historical release vintage

sources.provider: Simply Wall St Vietnam Tech sector
sources.pe_units: multiples; retain source PE and Absolute PE as separate fields
sources.limitation: 33 sparse snapshots from 2016-02-06 to 2025-07-24; no 2007 coverage, historical constituents or revision vintages. Not used as a model feature.
sources.modeling_status: excluded; retained for coverage audit only

sources.ebit_definition: pretax profit plus absolute interest expense
sources.availability_rule: quarter-end plus 45 calendar days, assumed; source statements may have been restated

sources.unit: shares outstanding, excluding treasury shares where separately reported
sources.availability_rule: Each CSV row records a publication/reference date and exact official report URL; applied one calendar day later
sources.limitation: Last-known archived observations, not a full daily register. The 2017 observation uses a conservative assumed availability date.
